tool_args.rationale: The shared-subtree guidance explicitly says to acquire the open_branch_discriminating_probe first. Its wider s_grad leverage can resolve the vmax/rho collinearity and help distinguish the open branch.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho collinear, so their values are not identifiable from these rows.
The stated ambiguity is s_grad leverage and branch identification; the open-branch probe directly addresses it at lower cost.
It does not address the identified parameter ambiguity and has higher cost.
